hypothesis: After deterministic multi-evidence aggregation is fixed, a verifier trained on claim-plus-evidence sets with explicit contradiction and insufficient-evidence contrasts may improve separation between CONTRADICTED and INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE without increasing unsupported positive verdicts.
decision_gate: Do not run until an audited multi-evidence dataset and Experiment 3 trainer exist. The pair-level Experiment 2 split and its held-out test must not be relabeled, threshold-tuned, or used for checkpoint selection.

data_sources.natural_source_role: licensed/public FEVER-NLI projection; source labels remain authoritative only after leakage and semantic-risk checks
data_sources.controlled_source: planned controlled contrast triples derived from documented contradiction/neutral patterns; not yet constructed
data_sources.held_out_test_policy: untouched; never used for prompt, threshold, hyperparameter, or checkpoint decisions

input_contract.format: claim plus up to three independently retrieved evidence passages

planned_splits.note: Measured by the deterministic preparation audit. The current rows are pair-level; one train near-duplicate pair at token Jaccard 0.86 must be excluded and deterministically replaced in a future Experiment 3-specific split.

leakage_controls.near_duplicate_audit: token Jaccard audit within source and claim group; review flagged pairs

near_duplicate_resolution.reason: Same claim group and CONTRADICTED label; the retained row contains the same factual contradiction without the longer row's unrelated retail/cultural sentence.
near_duplicate_resolution.replacement_policy: Deterministically select one non-duplicate CONTRADICTED row from the audited natural training pool after source snapshot hashing; do not alter validation or held-out test data.

training.best_checkpoint_metric: validation macro F1 from deterministic label evaluation
training.logging: JSON run metadata plus trainer log; report_to=none

promotion.rule: Promote only after the same untouched 180-sample protocol, reproducible metadata, acceptable latency, and no leakage. Macro F1 must exceed 0.6758189801, or be within 0.005 only when both CONTRADICTED recall and INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE F1 improve.
promotion.severe_class_collapse: No per-class F1 may decline by more than 0.03 from the baseline without an offsetting, documented improvement in the CONTRADICTED/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE boundary.
